modalLead: Search keeps the tab bar on the phone, and RSS headlines have a preview on a touch screen.

items.text: Search opens at once and keeps the tab bar. The bar stays under the search sheet, lifts above the keyboard, and Search is the highlighted tab.
RSS headlines have a preview on a touch screen. Tap or press and hold a headline for the summary and the buttons to open the article.
The Inbox selects are tall enough on an iPhone.
